canada.title: Halifax to look for cost saving options to bring forecasted property tax increase below CPI
canada.summary: Halifax council voted during Tuesday's budget committee meeting, for the city's top bureaucrat to search for ways to lower the forecasted average property tax increase from 6.8 per cent, to 5.4 per cent. Mayor Andy Filmore brought this amendment forward, stating an increase of 6.8 is "still too high", but staff say some of what they would bring forward to cut, are things council did not include in the past.

Nvidia board joins Jensen Huang under scrutiny after reinstating embattled CEO, The Associated Press reports.
One every four minutes: 720,000 Russian soldiers killed since start of Ukraine war, new data suggests, The Canadian Press reports.
Records: Government, judge debated constitutional implications of searching Rep. Ilhan Omar’s home, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
